from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityStats(BaseModel):
    """Admission and demographic statistics for one university from a CDS report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The university/institution name")
    admission_rate: float | None = Field(description="Admission rate as a percentage (0-100)")
    applicants_count: int | None = Field(description="Number of applicants reported in C1")
    admitted_count: int | None = Field(description="Number admitted students reported in C1")
    out_of_state_freshmen_percentage: float | None = Field(description="Percentage of first-time freshmen from out of state")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 'Fall 2021')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_stats: list[UniversityStats]
